subject: App stops working when tab added

messages.author: 306967f25f699560
messages.subject: App stops working when tab added
parts:
Dear Shiny users,

I have an app which grew pretty large now, but I wanted to add another tab. However,then it still runs but simply does not do anything. No errors. I have the idea that adding the tab causes this as it has reached some sort of limit (memory, or physical?). I tried out everything, and it really looks like simply adding the tab (which also with only say 1 button or so) causes the app to stop doing it's job. If this is caused by the memory of the app being to small, (I found "instances" here: http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/shinyapps.html paragraph application instances) how do you set this to be larger?

Regards,
Pieter de Wet
